newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from banking system intervention.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from banking system intervention.

text.p: The Federal Reserve remained out of the banking system during its usual midmorning intervention period Tuesday.
Economists had anticipated the lack of action because the Fed did not intervene Monday and the federal funds rate remained just slightly off target.
Fed funds were trading at 5-3/8 percent, below the Fed's current official target level of 5.50 percent.
On Monday, the effective fed funds rate was 5.43 pct, with a trading range between 5.0 and 5.875 percent.
